ANSWERS BEFORE THE NEXT STEP

GOOD QUESTIONS.

⌕

Do I need to know whether to repair or replace?+

No. Describe what is happening and share what you know about the equipment. An assessment and the proposed work can help you compare the options.

Can a heat pump heat and cool?+

Yes. Heat pumps transfer heat to provide heating and cooling. The right type and configuration depend on the space, climate, and existing system.

Can I choose equipment using square footage alone?+

Square footage is only part of the picture. Climate, insulation, windows, and other details matter. Ask a qualified contractor about a proper load calculation and equipment selection.

What should I bring to a first conversation?+

Your goals, problem rooms, current system information if you have it, and any maintenance or repair history. It is fine if some details are unknown.

Does this website book a real appointment?+

This is a fictional portfolio concept. The planner and request preview demonstrate an experience; they do not contact a company or reserve a time.
